title: Personal Checking: when deposits post and how daily debit limits apply
content:
## Scope

This policy governs when deposits to a Personal Checking account post, when a mobile deposit is accepted, and how the daily limits on ATM cash, debit card purchases and Zelle payments are applied. The mobile deposit limits, the debit limits, the new-account period and the new-account check hold are each tier's own published figures.

## Deposits

1. **Posting equals availability.** A deposit posts to the ledger on the business day its funds become available, so the ledger balance is also the available balance.
2. **Same-day credits.** Cash, direct deposits, ACH credits, incoming wires, Zelle receipts and internal transfers post on the business day received.
3. **Checks.** A deposited check posts on the next business day, except that while the account has been open fewer than the new-account period's calendar days, a deposited check posts on the tier's new-account check-hold business day after deposit.
4. **Mobile deposit.** A mobile deposit is accepted only when it keeps the day's mobile deposits within the tier's daily mobile limit and the mobile deposits of the rolling 30 calendar days ending on the deposit date, inclusive, within the tier's 30-day mobile limit. An over-limit mobile deposit is rejected and never posts.
5. **Account status.** Deposits are accepted on restricted and dormant accounts but not on closed or charged-off accounts.

## Debits

1. **Daily limits.** Debits are authorized only within the tier's daily limits, counted per calendar day in Eastern Time: ATM cash within the ATM limit, debit card purchases within the purchase limit, and Zelle payments within the daily Zelle limit and, measured over the rolling 30 calendar days ending on the payment date, inclusive, within the 30-day Zelle limit.
2. **Over a limit.** An authorization beyond a limit is declined and never posts.
3. **Paper checks.** Paper checks can be paid only on a tier on which paper checks can be written.
4. **Outside this policy.** Requests to raise a limit temporarily are outside this policy.

## Mobile deposit decision (hypothetical daily limit of 2000.00 USD and 30-day limit of 6000.00 USD, chosen only for illustration)

| Mobile deposits already today | Mobile deposits in the 30 days ending today | New mobile deposit | Accepted? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 3000.00 | 1500.00 | Yes: 1500.00 today and 4500.00 in 30 days are both within |
| 1200.00 | 3000.00 | 900.00 | No: today would reach 2100.00, over the daily limit |
| 0.00 | 5500.00 | 800.00 | No: the 30 days would reach 6300.00, over the 30-day limit |
| 500.00 | 4000.00 | 1500.00 | Yes: exactly 2000.00 today and 5500.00 in 30 days stay within |

## Basis Q&A

**Q: A check was deposited on a Monday to an account opened three years ago. When does it post?**
A: On the next business day, Tuesday, unless Tuesday is not a business day.

**Q: The customer wants a temporary increase to the Zelle limit for a large payment.**
A: Requests to raise a limit temporarily are outside this policy.

**Q: Can a charged-off account receive a deposit?**
A: No. Deposits are not accepted on closed or charged-off accounts.
